text:
Amelia W.: heads-up — candidate for ML Infra (final loop) is at 10:30am PT on Tues. I have a calendar conflict, can someone swap into my panelist slot? need someone to own the debrief and fill the rubric for system design.
people-ops-bot: @Amelia W. noted. If you share the candidate invite ID I can attempt an auto-swap and ping alternates. :gear:
Amelia W.: invite id 9887-ml-final. ideally someone who can ask infra + serving questions. also can we keep the session in Zoom room B (recording enabled) — candidate requested remote only.
Samir P.: I can take the slot if that's helpful. I have a lightweight follow-up note template I use — will own debrief. quick Q: do we want weighted rubric for infra vs culture? normally 70/30 but can flex.
Jordan R.: thanks Samir — yes please take it. 70/30 sounds right for this role. @people-ops-bot can you update the invite and add Samir as panelist and set the debrief owner to Samir P.?
people-ops-bot: Done — updated invite, added Samir P., set Zoom room to Zoom B (recording on). Notifying panelists: Amelia W., Samir P., Jordan R., Maria G. :white_check_mark:
Maria G.: confirmed I'll be there for the behavioral section. small ask: can we add the scoring rubric link in the calendar description? easier during live debrief. link: https://redwood-internal/docs/interview-rubrics/ml-infra
Amelia W.: thanks everyone — Samir, can you drop your debrief template in this thread after the interview? and Jordan, will you lead the hire/no-hire buffer if estimates are close?
Samir P.: yep — will paste my template below after the loop. quick template preview:
```
Candidate: 
Role fit summary (2-3 lines):
System design notes (strengths / gaps):
Latency/cost tradeoffs discussion:
Behavioral / collaboration:
Recommendation (hire / no-hire / hold) + confidence (1-5):
```
Jordan R.: I can lead the buffer discussion. if scores are within 1 point, let's do a 10-min sync right after. who will take notes during the debrief? Samir you can, but if you need me to capture I can.
Samir P.: I got notes. I'll post a short debrief doc in #hiring-notes afterwards and tag the hiring team. :memo:
people-ops-bot: Reminder set — 15min pre-interview ping to panel and 5min pre to candidate for setup. :alarm_clock:
Amelia W.: perfect. thanks y'all — appreciate the quick swap. :thumbsup:
